name: Chicken Adobo

Mix tomato sauce, sugar, vinegar, and garlic to make a BBQ sauce.
Grill the ribs while brushing with the sauce until sticky and charred.

name: Pulled Pork Sandwich
steps: Slow cook the pork with onion and water until it falls apart.
Shred the pork and mix with tomato sauce.
Serve the pulled pork inside the buns.

name: Macaroni and Cheese
steps: Boil the macaroni until tender.
Melt butter, whisk in flour, then add milk and cheese to make a sauce.
Mix the cooked macaroni with the cheese sauce and serve hot.

name: Chicken Caesar Salad
steps: Cook the chicken and slice it.
Toast the bread and cut into croutons.
Toss the lettuce, chicken, croutons, and cheese with a creamy dressing.

name: Beef Tacos
steps: Cook the beef with chopped onion until browned.
Warm the tortillas.
Fill with beef, chopped tomato, and cheese.

name: Beef Quesadilla
steps: Cook the beef with onion until browned.
Place beef and cheese on half a tortilla and fold.
Toast in a pan until crispy and cheese is melted.

name: Sweet and Sour Pork
steps: Fry the pork until golden brown.
Sauté bell pepper and pineapple.
Add vinegar and sugar, then toss the pork in the sauce until coated.

name: Shrimp Scampi
steps: Boil pasta until al dente.
Melt butter and sauté garlic and shrimp.
Toss with pasta, lemon juice, and serve.

name: Mushroom Risotto
steps: Sauté onion and mushroom in a pot.
Add rice and gradually add water, stirring until absorbed.
Stir in cheese and serve creamy.

name: Chicken Pot Pie
steps: Cook chicken and vegetables in a pan.
Make a creamy sauce with milk and flour.
Pour into a dish, top with a dough crust, and bake until golden.

name: Beef Bulgogi
steps: Marinate sliced beef in soy sauce, sugar, and garlic.
Stir-fry the beef and onion in a hot pan until cooked.
Serve with rice.

name: Egg Drop Soup
steps: Bring water and chopped onion to a boil.
Stir in soy sauce.
Slowly pour in beaten eggs while stirring to create ribbons.

name: Pork Sisig
steps: Boil the pork until tender, then grill or broil until crispy.
Chop the pork into small pieces and mix with chopped onion, soy sauce, calamansi, and chili.
Serve on a sizzling plate and top with an egg.

name: Beef Kare-Kare
steps: Boil the beef until very tender, saving the broth.
Sauté onion and garlic, add the beef broth and peanut butter, and simmer until thick.
Add the beef and blanched vegetables. Serve with a side of shrimp paste.

name: Lechon Kawali
steps: Boil the pork belly with salt and pepper until tender.
Let it dry completely, then deep fry until the skin is crispy and golden.
Chop into pieces and serve with lechon sauce.

name: Bicol Express
steps: Sauté garlic, onion, and pork until browned.
Add the shrimp paste, chili, and coconut milk.
Simmer until the pork is tender and the sauce is thick.

name: Laing
steps: Sauté garlic, onion, and shrimp paste.
Add the coconut milk and bring to a boil.
Add the taro leaves and simmer until tender and the sauce is thick.

name: Pinakbet
steps: Sauté tomato and shrimp paste.
Add the squash and a little water, and simmer until half-cooked.
Add the eggplant, green beans, and okra. Cook until tender.

name: Bulalo
steps: Boil the beef bones in water, skimming the scum.
Add the onion and corn, and simmer for 1-2 hours until the beef is tender.
Add the cabbage at the end and season with salt and pepper.

name: Arroz Caldo
steps: Sauté ginger, garlic, and chicken in a pot.
Add the rice and water, and simmer until the rice breaks down into a porridge.
Season with salt and top with fried garlic and a boiled egg.

name: Lumpiang Shanghai
steps: Mix ground pork with minced carrot and onion.
Wrap the mixture in lumpia wrappers.
Deep fry until golden brown and crispy. Serve with sweet chili sauce.

name: Pancit Palabok
steps: Boil the noodles until soft and place on a plate.
Cook a thick sauce using shrimp paste, garlic, and water.
Pour the sauce over the noodles and top with boiled eggs and shrimp.

name: Chicken Inasal
steps: Marinate the chicken in soy sauce, calamansi, and crushed garlic.
Grill over hot coals or pan-fry in oil until cooked through.
Serve with rice and a side of soy sauce and calamansi dip.

name: Beef Mechado
steps: Marinate the beef in soy sauce and lemon juice.
Sauté garlic and onion, add the beef, and brown it.
Add the tomato sauce and water, and simmer until the beef is tender. Add potatoes and cook until soft.

name: Pork Menudo
steps: Sauté onion and garlic, then add the pork and cook until browned.
Add the tomato sauce, water, and diced potatoes and carrots.
Simmer until the pork and vegetables are tender.

name: Chicken Afritada
steps: Sauté garlic, onion, and chicken.
Add the tomato sauce and water, and simmer until the chicken is cooked.
Add the potatoes, carrots, and bell pepper, and simmer until tender.

name: Beef Caldereta
steps: Sauté garlic and onion, then add the beef and cook until browned.
Add the tomato sauce and water, and simmer until the beef is tender.
Add the potatoes, carrots, bell pepper, and cheese. Cook until vegetables are soft.

name: Spaghetti Bolognese
steps: Boil the pasta in salted water until al dente.
Sauté onion and garlic, then add the ground beef until browned.
Add the tomato sauce and simmer for 15 minutes. Toss with pasta.

name: Beef Lasagna
steps: Boil lasagna noodles until soft.
Cook beef with onion and tomato sauce.
Layer noodles, meat sauce, and cheese in a dish. Bake at 180°C for 25 minutes.

name: Chicken Alfredo
steps: Boil pasta until al dente.
Cook sliced chicken and garlic in a pan.
Add cream and cheese, simmer until thick, and toss with pasta.

name: Pad Thai
steps: Soak noodles in warm water until soft.
Stir-fry shrimp and eggs in a wok.
Add noodles, soy sauce, and peanuts. Toss until heated through.

name: Beef Stroganoff
steps: Cook beef strips and onion in a pan until browned.
Add mushrooms and cream, and simmer.
Serve over cooked pasta.

name: Chili con Carne
steps: Sauté onion and beef until browned.
Add tomatoes, beans, and chili powder.
Simmer for 20 minutes until thick. Serve with rice or bread.

name: French Toast
steps: Whisk eggs and milk in a bowl.
Dip bread slices into the mixture.
Fry in butter until golden brown on both sides. Serve with syrup.

name: Buttermilk Waffles
steps: Mix dry ingredients, then whisk in eggs, milk, and melted butter.
Pour batter into a hot waffle iron.
Cook until golden and crisp. Serve with butter and syrup.

name: Shepherds Pie
steps: Cook beef, onion, and carrot in a pan.
Boil and mash potatoes with milk.
Layer beef mixture in a dish, top with mashed potatoes, and bake until golden.

name: Meatloaf
steps: Mix beef, onion, egg, and bread crumbs.
Shape into a loaf and place in a baking pan.
Top with tomato sauce and bake at 180°C for 45 minutes.

name: Fish and Chips
steps: Cut potatoes into fries and deep fry until golden.
Dip the fish in a batter made of flour and milk.
Deep fry the fish until crispy. Serve with the fries.

name: Tonkotsu Ramen
steps: Boil pork in water for 45 minutes to make a rich broth. Season with soy sauce.
Cook noodles in a separate pot.
Serve noodles in the broth, topped with sliced pork and a soft-boiled egg.

name: Chicken Katsu
steps: Coat chicken in flour, then egg, then bread crumbs.
Deep fry until golden brown and cooked through.
Slice and serve with rice and katsu sauce.

name: Bibimbap
steps: Stir-fry beef, carrot, and spinach separately.
Place hot rice in a bowl and arrange the toppings on top.
Top with a fried egg and serve with soy sauce.

name: Kimchi Fried Rice
steps: Stir-fry chopped kimchi in oil for 2 minutes.
Add rice and soy sauce, and stir-fry for 4 minutes.
Top with a fried egg.

name: Beef Pho
steps: Simmer beef, ginger, and onion in water for 1 hour to make broth.
Cook noodles and place in a bowl.
Top with thinly sliced raw beef and pour the hot broth over it.

name: Vegetable Spring Rolls
steps: Mix shredded cabbage and carrots.
Wrap the vegetables in spring roll wrappers.
Deep fry until golden and crispy.

name: Shrimp Tempura
steps: Mix flour and egg with cold water to make a batter.
Dip shrimp in batter and deep fry until crispy and golden.
Serve with a dipping sauce.

name: Miso Soup
steps: Bring water to a simmer and add chopped onion.
Add cubed tofu.
Turn off heat, dissolve miso paste into the soup, and serve.

name: Classic Cheeseburger
steps: Form beef into patties and grill or pan-fry until cooked.
Toast the buns.
Assemble with cheese, onion, and tomato.

name: Club Sandwich
steps: Toast the bread.
Cook chicken and bacon.
Layer bread, chicken, bacon, lettuce, and tomato, then top with another slice of bread.

name: BLT Sandwich
steps: Cook the bacon until crispy.
Toast the bread.
Layer bacon, lettuce, and tomato between the bread slices.

name: Tuna Melt
steps: Mix tuna with mayonnaise (if available) or butter.
Place tuna and cheese between two slices of bread.
Grill in a pan until the bread is golden and cheese is melted.

name: BBQ Pork Ribs
steps: Boil the pork ribs until tender.
Mix tomato sauce, sugar, vinegar, and garlic to make a BBQ sauce.
Grill the ribs while brushing with the sauce until sticky and charred.

name: Pulled Pork Sandwich
steps: Slow cook the pork with onion and water until it falls apart.
Shred the pork and mix with tomato sauce.
Serve the pulled pork inside the buns.

name: Macaroni and Cheese
steps: Boil the macaroni until tender.
Melt butter, whisk in flour, then add milk and cheese to make a sauce.
Mix the cooked macaroni with the cheese sauce and serve hot.

name: Chicken Caesar Salad
steps: Cook the chicken and slice it.
Toast the bread and cut into croutons.
Toss the lettuce, chicken, croutons, and cheese with a creamy dressing.

name: Beef Tacos
steps: Cook the beef with chopped onion until browned.
Warm the tortillas.
Fill with beef, chopped tomato, and cheese.

name: Beef Quesadilla
steps: Cook the beef with onion until browned.
Place beef and cheese on half a tortilla and fold.
Toast in a pan until crispy and cheese is melted.

name: Sweet and Sour Pork
steps: Fry the pork until golden brown.
Sauté bell pepper and pineapple.
Add vinegar and sugar, then toss the pork in the sauce until coated.

name: Shrimp Scampi
steps: Boil pasta until al dente.
Melt butter and sauté garlic and shrimp.
Toss with pasta, lemon juice, and serve.

name: Mushroom Risotto
steps: Sauté onion and mushroom in a pot.
Add rice and gradually add water, stirring until absorbed.
Stir in cheese and serve creamy.

name: Chicken Pot Pie
steps: Cook chicken and vegetables in a pan.
Make a creamy sauce with milk and flour.
Pour into a dish, top with a dough crust, and bake until golden.

name: Beef Bulgogi
steps: Marinate sliced beef in soy sauce, sugar, and garlic.
Stir-fry the beef and onion in a hot pan until cooked.
Serve with rice.

name: Egg Drop Soup
steps: Bring water and chopped onion to a boil.
Stir in soy sauce.
Slowly pour in beaten eggs while stirring to create ribbons.

name: Chicken Binakol
steps: Sauté ginger, onion, and chicken in a pot.
Pour in the coconut water and add the coconut meat.
Simmer until the chicken is tender. Season with salt and pepper.

name: Pork Hamonado
steps: Marinate the pork in soy sauce, sugar, and pineapple juice.
Sear the pork in a pot, then add the marinade and pineapple chunks.
Simmer until the pork is very tender and the sauce is thick.

name: Beef Nilaga
steps: Boil the beef in water with onion until tender.
Add the potatoes and cook until soft.
Add the cabbage and cook for 5 minutes. Season with salt and pepper.

name: Tokwa't Baboy
steps: Boil the pork until tender, then deep fry until crispy.
Deep fry the tofu until golden and cut into cubes.
Mix the pork and tofu with soy sauce, vinegar, and chopped onions.

name: Chicken Asado
steps: Sauté garlic and onion, then add the chicken and cook until browned.
Add soy sauce and sugar.
Simmer until the chicken is cooked and the sauce is thick.

name: Pininyahang Manok
steps: Sauté onion and chicken until browned.
Add the pineapple and bell pepper.
Pour in the milk and simmer until the chicken is tender.

name: Ginataang Hipon
steps: Sauté garlic and onion, then add the squash and green beans.
Pour in the coconut milk and simmer until vegetables are tender.
Add the shrimp and cook until pink.

name: Chicken Lollipop
steps: Fashion the chicken wings into lollipops and marinate in soy sauce.
Dip in egg and coat with flour.
Deep fry until golden brown.

name: Pork Estofado
steps: Sauté garlic and onion, then brown the pork.
Add tomato sauce, water, and sliced bananas (or plantains).
Simmer until pork is tender, then add potatoes and carrots.

name: Beef Asado
steps: Marinate beef in soy sauce and sugar.
Sauté onion and garlic, then add the beef and marinade.
Simmer until the beef is tender and the sauce is thick.

name: Pancit Luglug
steps: Boil the noodles and set aside.
Make a sauce with shrimp paste, flour, and water.
Pour the sauce over noodles and top with shrimp and boiled eggs.

name: Chicken Sopas
steps: Boil chicken in water until cooked, then shred.
Add pasta and carrots to the broth and cook until tender.
Stir in the milk and shredded chicken. Season to taste.

name: Lomi
steps: Boil water and add the pork until cooked.
Add the thick lomi noodles and cabbage.
Crack an egg into the soup and stir gently until cooked.

name: Beef Mami
steps: Simmer beef with garlic and onion in water until tender.
Cook the noodles separately and place in a bowl.
Pour the hot beef broth and sliced beef over the noodles.

name: Pork Afritada
steps: Sauté garlic, onion, and pork until browned.
Add tomato sauce and water, and simmer until pork is tender.
Add potatoes, carrots, and bell pepper. Cook until soft.

name: Chicken Pastel
steps: Cook chicken and onion in a pot with a little water.
Add sliced sausages and potatoes.
Pour in the milk and simmer until the sauce is creamy.

name: Chicken Tikka Masala
steps: Sauté onion and chicken in a pan.
Add curry powder and tomato sauce, and simmer for 15 minutes.
Stir in the cream and cook for another 5 minutes. Serve with rice.

name: Roast Chicken
steps: Rub the chicken with butter, salt, and pepper. Stuff with lemon.
Place in a roasting pan with potatoes and carrots.
Roast at 200°C for 45 minutes until golden and cooked through.

name: Beef Pot Roast
steps: Sear the beef in a large pot.
Add water, onion, potatoes, and carrots.
Cover and simmer for 1.5 hours until the beef falls apart.

name: Chicken Tenders
steps: Slice chicken into strips.
Dip in egg then coat with flour.
Deep fry until golden and crispy.

name: Honey Garlic Chicken
steps: Sear chicken in a pan until golden.
Mix honey, garlic, and soy sauce. Pour over the chicken.
Simmer until the chicken is cooked and the sauce is sticky.

name: Teriyaki Salmon
steps: Mix soy sauce, sugar, and ginger.
Pan-fry the salmon until almost cooked.
Pour in the sauce and simmer until it thickens and glazes the salmon.

name: Lemon Butter Pasta
steps: Boil pasta until al dente.
Melt butter and mix with lemon juice and zest.
Toss the pasta in the lemon butter and top with cheese.

name: Garlic Bread
steps: Mix softened butter with minced garlic.
Spread on the bread slices.
Toast in the oven or a pan until golden.

name: Caesar Wrap
steps: Cook and slice the chicken.
Toss lettuce and chicken with Caesar dressing (or mayonnaise).
Wrap in tortillas with cheese.

name: Buffalo Wings
steps: Bake or fry the chicken wings until crispy.
Melt butter and mix with vinegar and chili (hot sauce).
Toss the cooked wings in the spicy sauce.

name: Mozzarella Sticks
steps: Cut mozzarella into sticks.
Dip in egg and coat with bread crumbs. Freeze for 10 minutes.
Deep fry until golden brown.

name: Pizza Margherita
steps: Roll out the dough.
Spread tomato sauce and top with cheese and sliced tomatoes.
Bake at 220°C for 10-12 minutes until crust is golden.

name: Cheeseburger Sliders
steps: Form small beef patties and cook in a pan.
Top with cheese and let melt.
Place in small buns with chopped onion.

name: Beef and Barley Soup
steps: Sear beef in a pot with onion.
Add water, carrots, and barley.
Simmer for 45 minutes until the beef is tender and barley is soft.

name: French Onion Soup
steps: Slowly caramelize sliced onions in butter (about 20 minutes).
Add water (or beef broth) and simmer for 15 minutes.
Top with toasted bread and cheese, then broil until melted.

name: Bruschetta
steps: Toast the bread slices.
Rub raw garlic on the toasted bread.
Top with diced tomatoes mixed with oil, salt, and pepper.

name: Caprese Salad
steps: Slice the tomatoes and mozzarella cheese.
Arrange them on a plate, alternating slices.
Drizzle with oil, salt, and pepper.

name: Chicken Piccata
steps: Coat chicken in flour and pan-fry until golden.
Remove chicken. In the same pan, add lemon juice and butter.
Pour the sauce over the chicken and serve.

name: Sloppy Joes
steps: Cook beef and onion until browned.
Add tomato sauce and simmer for 10 minutes.
Spoon the mixture onto buns and serve.

name: Veggie Quesadilla
steps: Sauté bell pepper, onion, and mushrooms until soft.
Place vegetables and cheese on a tortilla and fold.
Toast in a pan until golden and cheese is melted.

name: Jambalaya
steps: Sauté sausage, onion, and bell pepper.
Add shrimp and cook until pink.
Stir in the cooked rice and season with salt and pepper.

name: Gumbo
steps: Brown the sausage with onion and bell pepper.
Add water and simmer for 20 minutes.
Add shrimp and cook for 5 minutes. Serve over rice.

name: Baked Potato Soup
steps: Boil potatoes until soft and mash them slightly.
Fry bacon and onion, then add to the potatoes with milk.
Simmer until thick, then top with cheese.

name: Broccoli Cheddar Soup
steps: Boil broccoli and onion in water until tender.
Blend slightly, then stir in milk and cheese.
Heat until the cheese is melted and the soup is creamy.

name: Beef Chili
steps: Brown the beef with chopped onion.
Add tomatoes, beans, and chili powder.
Simmer for 25 minutes until thick.

name: Chicken Potstickers
steps: Mix ground chicken, cabbage, and soy sauce.
Wrap in dumpling wrappers.
Pan-fry until the bottoms are crispy, then add a little water and cover to steam.

name: Pork Gyoza
steps: Mix ground pork, cabbage, and soy sauce.
Wrap in dumpling wrappers.
Pan-fry until crispy, then steam with a splash of water.

name: Vegetable Lo Mein
steps: Boil noodles until soft.
Stir-fry carrots, bell pepper, and cabbage in a wok.
Add noodles and soy sauce, and toss until well mixed.

name: Beef and Broccoli
steps: Stir-fry beef and garlic until browned.
Add broccoli and a splash of water, cover to steam for 3 minutes.
Add soy sauce and toss until coated.

name: Sweet and Sour Chicken
steps: Fry chicken until golden.
Sauté bell pepper and pineapple.
Add vinegar and sugar, then toss the chicken in the sauce.

name: Orange Chicken
steps: Coat chicken in flour and fry until crispy.
Make a sauce with orange juice, sugar, and vinegar.
Toss the chicken in the sauce until coated.

name: Sesame Chicken
steps: Coat chicken in flour and fry until crispy.
Mix soy sauce and sugar, and simmer until thick.
Toss chicken in the sauce and sprinkle with sesame seeds.

name: Mongolian Beef
steps: Slice beef thinly and fry in a hot pan.
Add sliced onion.
Mix soy sauce and sugar, pour over beef, and cook until sticky.

name: Fried Ice Cream
steps: Scoop ice cream into balls and freeze until hard.
Dip in egg and coat with bread crumbs. Freeze again.
Deep fry quickly until golden and serve immediately.

name: Pork BBQ Skewers
steps: Slice pork thinly and marinate in soy sauce, sugar, lemon, and garlic.
Thread the pork onto skewers.
Grill over hot coals or pan-fry until cooked and slightly charred.

name: Kwek-Kwek (Orange Quail Eggs)
steps: Boil the quail eggs, peel them, and set aside.
Mix flour, water, and orange food coloring to make a batter.
Coat the eggs in batter and deep fry until crispy.

name: Arroz a la Cubana
steps: Sauté ground beef with garlic and onion until cooked.
Fry the sliced potatoes and bananas separately.
Serve the beef, potatoes, bananas, and a fried egg over rice.

name: Pancit Malabon
steps: Boil thick rice noodles and set aside.
Sauté shrimp, cabbage, and shrimp paste. Add a little water to make a sauce.
Toss the noodles in the sauce and top with sliced boiled eggs.

name: Pancit Molo
steps: Mix ground pork with garlic and onion, and wrap in dumpling wrappers.
Boil the dumplings in water to make a savory broth.
Season with salt and pepper and serve hot.

name: La Paz Batchoy
steps: Simmer pork in water with garlic to make a rich broth.
Cook noodles separately and place in a bowl.
Pour the broth and sliced pork over the noodles, topping with a raw egg and crispy pork rinds.

name: Pata Tim
steps: Boil pork leg until tender, then set aside.
In a pot, mix soy sauce, vinegar, sugar, and garlic to make a sweet-savory sauce.
Simmer the pork in the sauce until it becomes sticky and glazed.

name: Paksiw na Pata
steps: Place the pork, vinegar, soy sauce, and garlic in a pot.
Add the sliced banana (or banana blossoms) and a little water.
Simmer until the pork is tender and the sauce is reduced.

name: Halabos na Hipon
steps: Melt butter in a pan and sauté garlic.
Add the shrimp and water.
Cover and simmer until the shrimp turns pink and the water evaporates.

name: Inihaw na Pusit
steps: Marinate the squid in soy sauce, lemon, and sugar for 10 minutes.
Grill over hot coals for 3-4 minutes per side.
Slice and serve with a vinegar dip.

name: Kinilaw na Tuna
steps: Cut fresh tuna into cubes.
Soak the tuna in vinegar for 5 minutes to cure it.
Drain and mix with chopped onion, ginger, and chili. Serve chilled.

name: Igado
steps: Sauté garlic and onion, then add the pork and liver.
Add vinegar and soy sauce, and simmer for 15 minutes.
Add the bell pepper and cook until tender.

name: Dinakdakan
steps: Boil pork until tender, then grill until slightly charred. Chop into small pieces.
Mix the pork with chopped onion, chili, vinegar, and lemon juice.
Serve with a creamy mayonnaise-based sauce if desired.

name: Poqui-poqui
steps: Grill the eggplants until soft, then peel and mash them.
Sauté onion and tomato, then add the mashed eggplant.
Pour in beaten eggs and scramble until cooked.

name: Ilocos Bagnet
steps: Boil pork belly in salted water until tender.
Air dry, then deep fry until the skin is completely crispy and blistered.
Chop and serve with chopped tomatoes.

name: Pork Embutido
steps: Mix ground pork, chopped sausage, carrots, eggs, and bread crumbs.
Shape into a log and wrap tightly in foil.
Steam for 45 minutes, then let it cool before slicing.

name: Everlasting (Marikina Meatloaf)
steps: Mix ground pork with chopped carrots, bell peppers, and tomato sauce.
Place in a loaf pan and top with cheese.
Bake at 180°C for 40 minutes until cooked through.

name: Valenciana
steps: Sauté chicken, sausage, bell pepper, and carrots.
Add the cooked rice and mix well.
Cook for another 5 minutes to let the flavors blend.

name: Callos
steps: Boil beef tripe (or beef chunks) until very tender.
Sauté sausage, carrots, and bell pepper.
Add the beef, tomato sauce, and broth. Simmer until thick.

name: Lengua Estofada
steps: Boil ox tongue (or beef) until tender and slice.
Sauté onion and add the meat, tomato sauce, and potatoes.
Simmer until potatoes are soft, then top with cheese.

name: Bangus Sisig
steps: Fry or grill the bangus (milkfish) until crispy, then flake the meat.
Mix the fish with chopped onion, soy sauce, lemon, and chili.
Serve sizzling on a hot plate.

name: Tuna Sisig
steps: Drain the tuna and mix with chopped onion, chili, and lemon.
Cook in a hot pan for 3 minutes.
Crack an egg over the mixture, stir until cooked, and serve.

name: Chicken Sisig
steps: Boil and shred the chicken, then fry until slightly crispy.
Mix with chopped onion, soy sauce, lemon, and chili.
Serve hot on a sizzling plate.

name: Sizzling Gambas
steps: Melt butter in a sizzling plate or pan.
Sauté garlic, onion, and chili.
Add the shrimp and cook until pink and coated in the garlic butter sauce.

name: Cheesy Baked Tahong
steps: Clean the mussels and boil until the shells open.
Mix minced garlic with softened butter and top each mussel.
Sprinkle with cheese and bake at 200°C until the cheese melts.

name: Hawaiian Pizza
steps: Roll out the pizza dough and spread tomato sauce.
Top with cheese, ham, and pineapple chunks.
Bake at 220°C for 12-15 minutes until crust is golden.

name: Pepperoni Pizza
steps: Roll out the dough and spread tomato sauce.
Top with cheese and pepperoni slices.
Bake at 220°C for 12-15 minutes until crispy.

name: Beef Shawarma Rice
steps: Marinate and pan-fry the beef with curry powder until cooked.
Serve the beef over rice.
Top with chopped cucumber and tomato.

name: Pork Katsu Curry
steps: Coat pork in bread crumbs and fry until crispy. Slice.
Boil potatoes and carrots in water with curry powder to make a curry sauce.
Serve the sliced pork katsu over rice with the curry sauce.

name: Chicken Karaage
steps: Marinate chicken in soy sauce and garlic.
Coat in flour.
Deep fry until golden and crispy.

name: Oyakodon
steps: Simmer chicken and sliced onion in soy sauce and a little water.
Pour beaten eggs over the chicken and cover until the eggs are just set.
Slide the mixture over a bowl of hot rice.

name: Katsudon
steps: Bread and fry the pork until crispy, then slice.
Simmer onion and sliced pork in a pan with soy sauce and water.
Pour beaten egg over the top, cover to cook, and serve over rice.

name: Gyudon
steps: Simmer thinly sliced beef and onions in soy sauce and sugar.
Cook until the beef is tender and the sauce is slightly thick.
Serve over a bowl of warm rice.

name: Japchae
steps: Boil sweet potato noodles and set aside.
Stir-fry carrots and spinach.
Mix the noodles and vegetables with soy sauce and sugar.

name: Tteokbokki
steps: Boil water and add the rice cakes and sliced onion.
Add soy sauce, sugar, and chili paste (or chopped chili).
Simmer until the sauce thickens and the rice cakes are soft.

name: Buldak (Spicy Fire Chicken)
steps: Stir-fry chicken with garlic, soy sauce, and lots of chili until cooked.
Transfer to a pan and top with melted cheese.
Serve very hot with rice.

name: Beef Wellington
steps: Sear the beef fillet until browned.
Wrap the beef in ham and a mushroom mixture.
Wrap in pastry dough, brush with egg, and bake at 200°C for 25 minutes.

name: Ratatouille
steps: Slice all vegetables thinly.
Sauté onion and bell pepper, then spread them on the bottom of a baking dish.
Arrange the sliced vegetables on top, drizzle with oil, and bake for 30 minutes.

name: Quiche Lorraine
steps: Press dough into a pie pan to make the crust.
Sprinkle cooked bacon and cheese over the crust.
Whisk eggs and milk, pour into the crust, and bake at 180°C for 30 minutes.

name: Beef Bourguignon
steps: Sear the beef in a pot, then add carrots, onion, and mushrooms.
Pour in water (traditionally red wine) and bring to a boil.
Cover and simmer for 1 hour until the beef is very tender.

name: Coq au Vin
steps: Brown the chicken pieces in a pot.
Add onions, carrots, and mushrooms.
Pour in water (or wine) and simmer for 40 minutes until the chicken is tender.

name: Chicken and Waffles
steps: Coat chicken in flour and deep fry until crispy.
Mix flour, eggs, and milk to make waffle batter. Cook in a waffle iron.
Serve the crispy chicken on top of the waffles.

name: Biscuits and Gravy
steps: Make biscuits by mixing flour, milk, and butter, and bake until golden.
Fry the sausage and crumble it into a pan with milk and flour to make a white gravy.
Pour the sausage gravy over the warm biscuits.

name: Philly Cheesesteak
steps: Slice the beef very thinly and stir-fry with onions and bell peppers.
Melt cheese over the meat mixture in the pan.
Scoop the cheesy meat into a sliced bread roll.

name: Reuben Sandwich
steps: Layer sliced corned beef, cheese, and sauerkraut (or cabbage) between bread slices.
Butter the outside of the bread.
Grill in a pan until the bread is toasted and cheese is melted.

name: Gyro Sandwich
steps: Cook the beef with Mediterranean spices and slice it.
Warm the pita bread and spread with a cucumber-yogurt sauce (or cream).
Fill with the meat, chopped onions, and tomatoes.

name: Falafel Wrap
steps: Mash chickpeas with flour and spices to form small patties.
Pan-fry the patties in oil until crispy.
Wrap the falafel in tortillas with sliced cucumber and a creamy sauce.

name: Greek Salad
steps: Chop the tomatoes, cucumber, and onion into large chunks.
Toss with olive oil and salt.
Top with a block of feta cheese and serve.

name: Chicken Biryani
steps: Sauté onions and chicken with curry powder until browned.
Add the cream and simmer until the chicken is cooked.
Layer the chicken and cooked rice in a pot, cover, and steam for 10 minutes.

name: Palak Paneer
steps: Blanch and blend the spinach into a puree.
Sauté onions and curry powder, then add the spinach puree and cream.
Add cubes of firm tofu (or paneer cheese) and simmer for 10 minutes.

name: Pochero (Beef Stew with Saba)
steps: Boil the beef until tender, saving the broth.
Sauté onion and garlic, add the beef and tomato sauce.
Add the broth and saba bananas. Simmer until the bananas are soft, then add the cabbage.

name: Humba (Visayan Sweet Pork)
steps: Sear the pork in a pot until browned.
Add vinegar, soy sauce, sugar, and pineapple chunks.
Simmer for 45 minutes until the pork is very tender and the sauce is thick.

name: Kansi (Ilonggo Sour Beef Soup)
steps: Boil the beef in water until very tender.
Add the tamarind mix to create a sour broth.
Add the saba banana and radish, and simmer until tender. Season with salt.

name: Sinanglay (Fish in Taro Leaves)
steps: Wrap the fish fillets in taro leaves.
Place in a pan with coconut milk, onion, and chili.
Simmer gently for 15-20 minutes until the fish is cooked and the leaves are tender.

name: Kinunot (Shredded Fish in Coconut)
steps: Boil the fish until cooked, then shred the meat.
Sauté onion and chili, then add the coconut milk.
Add the shredded fish and spinach. Simmer until the sauce thickens.

name: Tiyula Itum (Black Beef Stew)
steps: Sear the beef with garlic, onion, and ginger.
Add the coconut milk and bring to a simmer.
Cook until the beef is tender and the sauce is thick and dark.

name: Chicken Cacciatore
steps: Brown the chicken pieces in a pan.
Add onions, bell peppers, and mushrooms, and sauté.
Pour in the tomato sauce and simmer for 25 minutes until the chicken is cooked.

name: Pork Tacos al Pastor
steps: Marinate thinly sliced pork in chili and spices.
Sear the pork in a hot pan until cooked and slightly charred.
Serve on warm tortillas with chopped pineapple and onion.

name: Laksa
steps: Sauté curry powder in a pot, then add coconut milk and water.
Bring to a boil, then add the shrimp and cook until pink.
Pour the soup over cooked noodles and serve.

name: Beef Rendang
steps: Blend onion, garlic, and chili into a paste.
Sear the beef with the paste, then pour in the coconut milk.
Simmer for 1 hour until the beef is tender and the sauce is completely reduced and dark.

name: Tom Yum Goong
steps: Boil water with ginger and chili.
Add mushrooms and shrimp, and cook until the shrimp are pink.
Season with lemon juice and salt for a spicy-sour flavor.

name: Pad See Ew
steps: Stir-fry chicken in a hot wok.
Add flat rice noodles and soy sauce.
Push noodles aside, scramble the eggs, then mix with sugar and serve.

name: Banh Mi
steps: Pickle the shredded carrots in vinegar and sugar.
Cook the pork and slice it.
Stuff the bread with pork, pickled carrots, and sliced cucumber.

name: Paella
steps: Sauté bell peppers and shrimp in a wide pan.
Add rice and curry powder (as a substitute for saffron).
Pour in the water and simmer without stirring until the rice is cooked.

name: Chicken Mole Poblano
steps: Boil the chicken until cooked and shred it.
Blend tomato sauce, chili powder, peanut butter, and garlic to make a mole sauce.
Simmer the chicken in the sauce for 15 minutes.

name: Shakshuka
steps: Sauté onion and bell pepper in a pan.
Add canned tomatoes and simmer to make a thick sauce.
Make small wells in the sauce and crack the eggs into them. Cover and cook until eggs are set.

name: Eggs Benedict
steps: Poach the eggs in simmering water.
Toast the bread and top with ham.
Place the poached egg on top and drizzle with a lemon-butter sauce.

name: Avocado Toast
steps: Toast the bread.
Mash the avocado with lemon juice, salt, and pepper.
Spread on the toast and top with a fried egg.

name: Chilaquiles
steps: Fry the tortilla chips until crispy.
Simmer the tomato sauce and pour over the chips.
Top with fried eggs and cheese.

name: Crab Cakes
steps: Mix crab meat, bread crumbs, and egg to form patties.
Pan-fry in oil until golden brown on both sides.
Serve with a squeeze of lemon.

name: Lobster Roll
steps: Cook the lobster meat and chop it into chunks.
Mix with cream and butter.
Stuff the mixture into a toasted bread roll.

name: Lobster Bisque
steps: Sauté onion in butter, then add the lobster and water.
Simmer for 20 minutes, then blend until smooth.
Stir in the cream and heat through.

name: Fried Green Tomatoes
steps: Slice the tomatoes and dip in egg, then flour.
Deep fry in hot oil until golden brown.
Season with salt and serve.

name: Cornbread
steps: Mix flour, cornmeal (or blended corn), milk, and egg.
Pour into a buttered baking pan.
Bake at 200°C for 20 minutes until golden.

name: Pulled Chicken Sandwich
steps: Boil and shred the chicken.
Mix tomato sauce, sugar, and the chicken in a pan and simmer.
Serve on buns topped with shredded cabbage.

name: Pork Chops with Mushroom Gravy
steps: Pan-fry the pork chops until cooked, then set aside.
In the same pan, sauté mushrooms in butter and sprinkle with flour.
Stir in the milk to make a gravy, then return the pork chops to the pan.

name: Chicken Fried Steak
steps: Pound the beef flat. Dip in egg and coat with flour.
Pan-fry in oil until golden brown.
Make a white gravy using milk and flour, and pour over the steak.

name: Chicken and Dumplings
steps: Boil chicken with onion in water to make a broth.
Mix flour and milk into a dough and drop spoonfuls into the boiling broth.
Simmer until the dumplings are cooked and the broth thickens.

name: Maja Blanca
steps: Mix all ingredients in a pot.
Stir constantly over medium heat until the mixture thickens.
Pour into a mold and let it cool and set before serving.

name: Sapin-sapin
steps: Mix rice flour, coconut milk, and sugar into a batter.
Divide the batter into layers and color them separately if desired.
Steam each layer one by one until fully cooked and set.

name: Buko Pandan
steps: Mix the coconut meat, cream, milk, and sugar in a bowl.
Chill in the refrigerator for at least an hour.
Serve cold as a dessert.

name: Cassava Cake
steps: Grate the cassava and mix with coconut milk, sugar, and eggs.
Pour into a baking dish.
Bake at 180°C for 45 minutes until set and golden.

name: Ube Halaya
steps: Boil and mash the ube (purple yam).
In a pot, mix the mashed ube, coconut milk, sugar, and butter.
Stir constantly over low heat until thick and smooth.

name: Pichi-pichi
steps: Mix grated cassava with sugar and water to form small balls.
Steam for 20 minutes until translucent.
Roll in grated coconut before serving.

name: Buko Pie
steps: Make a pie crust using flour and butter, and press into a pan.
Fill with a mixture of coconut meat, milk, and sugar.
Cover with another layer of crust and bake at 180°C for 30 minutes.

name: Ensaymada
steps: Make a soft dough with flour, milk, eggs, and sugar.
Shape into spirals and bake until golden.
Top with butter and grated cheese.

name: Pan de Sal
steps: Mix flour, milk, sugar, and butter into a dough.
Shape into small rolls and coat with bread crumbs.
Bake at 180°C for 15-20 minutes until golden.

name: Beef Salpicao
steps: Sear the beef cubes in a hot pan with butter.
Add lots of minced garlic and soy sauce.
Cook until the beef is tender, then finish with a squeeze of lemon.

name: Adobong Dilaw (Yellow Adobo)
steps: Sauté garlic, onion, ginger, and turmeric.
Add the chicken and cook until browned.
Pour in vinegar and soy sauce, and simmer until the chicken is tender.

name: Asadong Manok (Chicken Asado)
steps: Sauté garlic and onion, then add the chicken and cook until browned.
Add soy sauce and sugar.
Simmer until the chicken is cooked and the sauce is thick.

name: Sinigang na Corned Beef
steps: Boil water with onion and radish.
Add the tamarind mix.
Add the corned beef and simmer for 10 minutes. Serve hot.

name: Goto (Beef Tripe Porridge)
steps: Simmer beef tripe (or beef chunks) with ginger and garlic until tender.
Add the rice and water, and simmer until the rice breaks down into a porridge.
Season with salt and top with fried garlic.

name: Pinaputok na Tilapia
steps: Stuff the tilapia with chopped tomato, onion, and ginger.
Wrap in banana leaves or foil.
Grill or bake for 20 minutes, then serve with lemon.

name: Inihaw na Bangus
steps: Clean the bangus and stuff with chopped tomato and onion.
Grill over hot coals for 10 minutes per side.
Serve with a vinegar dipping sauce.

name: Daing na Bangus
steps: Marinate the butterflied bangus in vinegar and garlic for 10 minutes.
Pan-fry in hot oil until crispy and golden.
Serve with garlic fried rice and eggs.

name: Tortang Giniling
steps: Sauté onion, potato, and ground pork until cooked.
Beat the eggs and mix with the cooked meat.
Fry the mixture in oil until golden brown on both sides.

name: Ginisang Togue
steps: Sauté garlic and onion, then add the tofu and carrots.
Add the bean sprouts and soy sauce.
Stir-fry for 3 minutes until the sprouts are slightly tender.

name: Ginisang Pechay
steps: Sauté garlic, onion, and ground pork.
Add the pechay stalks and cook for 2 minutes.
Add the leaves and soy sauce, and cook until wilted.

name: Chopsuey
steps: Sauté garlic and onion.
Add all the vegetables and stir-fry for 5 minutes.
Add soy sauce and a little water, and cook until tender-crisp.

name: Sotanghon Guisado
steps: Soak the glass noodles in water until soft.
Stir-fry chicken, carrots, and cabbage.
Add the noodles and soy sauce, and toss until well mixed.
